questionText:
Read the following marine ecology and climate science case study and answer the questions that follow:

Coral reefs, often celebrated as the 'rainforests of the sea', cover less than 0.1% of the ocean floor yet harbor over 25% of all marine species. These biogenic limestone structures are created by tiny calcifying anthozoan coral polyps living in an obligate mutualistic symbiosis with photosynthetic microscopic dinoflagellate microalgae known as 'Zooxanthellae' (genus Symbiodinium). Zooxanthellae reside within the coral gastrodermal tissues, photosynthesizing and providing up to 90% of the polyp's metabolic energy in the form of glycerol, glucose, and amino acids, while receiving inorganic nutrients and shelter in return. However, anthropogenic global warming and rising atmospheric CO2 pose an existential double jeopardy: Marine Heatwaves and Ocean Acidification. When ocean sea surface temperatures rise merely 1 to 1.5 degrees Celsius above normal summer maximums for sustained weeks, the photosynthetic apparatus of zooxanthellae breaks down, producing toxic Reactive Oxygen Species (ROS) that damage coral cellular membranes. To survive, the stressed coral host actively expels the zooxanthellae, revealing the stark white, translucent calcium carbonate skeleton beneath—a phenomenon termed 'Mass Coral Bleaching'. Simultaneously, rising oceanic absorption of CO2 lowers seawater pH and depletes Carbonate ions (CO3(2-)), drastically depressing the Aragonite Saturation State (\Omega_arag) and making it energetically exhausting or impossible for bleached corals to rebuild their structural skeletons.

Question: Although coral reefs cover less than 0.1% of the global ocean surface area, they support approximately what proportion of all marine biological species?

options.text: Over 25% of all marine species
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately solves the problem for Biodiversity Significance of Coral Reefs.

options.text: Exactly 100% of all organisms on Earth
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: Less than 0.001% of marine life
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: Only microscopic bacterial species
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
For Biodiversity Significance of Coral Reefs (Development and Environment):
Coral reefs are global marine biodiversity hotspots, supporting over one-fourth of all marine fishes, invertebrates, and pelagic species on just 0.1% of ocean floor.
Hence, Option B is correct.

Therefore, option (A) is the correct answer.

questionText:
Match the AQI score range in List I with its official category in List II:

List I:
(A) 0 to 50
(B) 101 to 200
(C) 201 to 300
(D) 401 to 500

List II:
(I) Good (Minimal health impact)
(II) Moderate (Breathing discomfort to people with asthma and heart diseases)
(III) Poor (Breathing discomfort to most people on prolonged exposure)
(IV) Severe (Affects healthy people and seriously impacts those with existing diseases)

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: A-II, B-I, C-III, D-IV

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
0-50 is Good, 101-200 is Moderate, 201-300 is Poor, and 401-500 is Severe.
Hence, Option A is correct.
Hence, option (B) is the correct match.

topic: Key River Action Programs and Milestones
questionText:
Arrange the statutory procedural steps for recognizing community forest rights under the Forest Rights Act, 2006:
(I) The Gram Sabha convenes and elects the village Forest Rights Committee (FRC) to receive and verify claims
(II) The FRC conducts physical ground verification of traditional boundaries, prepares maps, and submits findings to the Gram Sabha
(III) The Gram Sabha deliberates, passes a formal resolution approving the rights, and forwards it to the Sub-Divisional Level Committee (SDLC)
(IV) The District Level Committee (DLC) gives final statutory approval and issues formal land title deeds (patta) signed by the District Collector

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

options.text: I -> III -> II -> IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: II -> I -> III -> IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: I -> II -> III -> IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.

options.text: IV -> II -> III -> I
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
FRA process: Gram Sabha elects FRC, FRC maps claims, Gram Sabha passes resolution, and District Level Committee (DLC) issues final titles.
Hence, Option B is correct.
Hence, option (C) is correct.

options.text: It conforms strictly to the standard equilibrium conditions defined in NCERT Development and Environment.
